title: Host detail
description: One machine through the USE method: utilization, saturation and errors for CPU, memory, disk and network, then its journal and the connections it accepted.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: search
list.label: Log search
list.description: Text the journal lines must contain. Empty shows every line.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of all cores doing work.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - sum(rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle", host_name="$host" or state="idle", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Load/core
panels.description: 5 minute load average divided by core count. Above 1 means runnable tasks wait for a CPU.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(system_cpu_load_average_5m{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m])) / max(last_over_time(system_cpu_logical_count{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]) or count(count by (cpu) (last_over_time(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle",host_name="$host" or state="idle",k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory held by processes, page cache excluded.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(system_memory_usage_bytes{state="used", host_name="$host" or state="used", k8s_node_name="$host"}) / sum(system_memory_usage_bytes{state=~"used|free|buffered|cached", host_name="$host" or state=~"used|free|buffered|cached", k8s_node_name="$host"})

panels.title: Root disk
panels.description: Used share of the root filesystem.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint="/",state="used", host_name="$host" or mountpoint="/",state="used", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m])) / sum(last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint="/",state=~"used|free", host_name="$host" or mountpoint="/",state=~"used|free", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))

panels.title: Cores
panels.description: Logical CPUs the host reports.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time(system_cpu_logical_count{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]) or count(count by (cpu) (last_over_time(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle",host_name="$host" or state="idle",k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Last data
panels.description: Seconds since the newest metric from this host. Above 2 minutes means its collector stopped reporting.

targets.expr: time() - max(tlast_over_time(system_memory_usage_bytes{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[1h]))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Error lines in this host's journal and its pods over the selected range.

targets.expr: (host.name:="$host" or k8s.node.name:="$host") severity_number:>=17 | stats count() errors

panels.title: CPU by state
panels.description: Share of all cores per state. iowait means waiting on disk; steal means the hypervisor gave the time to another guest.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (state) (rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state!="idle", host_name="$host" or state!="idle", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Load against cores
panels.description: Run-queue length as load averages, with the core count as a line. Load above the line is saturation.

targets.expr: sum(system_cpu_load_average_1m{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"})
sum(system_cpu_load_average_5m{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"})
sum(system_cpu_load_average_15m{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"})

max(last_over_time(system_cpu_logical_count{host_name="$host" or k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__interval]) or count(count by (cpu) (last_over_time(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle",host_name="$host" or state="idle",k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__interval]))))

panels.title: Memory by state
panels.description: Used is held by processes. Cached and buffered hold file data the kernel frees on demand.

targets.expr: sum by (state) (system_memory_usage_bytes{state=~"used|free|buffered|cached", host_name="$host" or state=~"used|free|buffered|cached", k8s_node_name="$host"})

panels.title: Pods on this node by memory
panels.description: Working set of the ten largest pods on this node. Empty on hosts outside the cluster.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (k8s_pod_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_node_name="$host"}))

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each device had I/O in flight. Near 100 % the device is saturated.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(system_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second. Writes plot below zero.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (rate(system_disk_io_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*",direction="read", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*",direction="read", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

-sum by (device) (rate(system_disk_io_bytes_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*",direction="write", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*",direction="write", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Disk latency
panels.description: Average time per completed operation. Spinning disks sit around 10 ms, SSDs below 1 ms.

targets.expr: sum by (device, direction) (rate(system_disk_operation_time_seconds_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (device, direction) (rate(system_disk_operations_total{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Space and inodes per mounted filesystem. Either one running out stops writes.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint=~"$mount",state="used", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount",state="used", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m])) / sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint=~"$mount",state=~"used|free", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount",state=~"used|free", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))
sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint=~"$mount",state="free", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount",state="free", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))
sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_usage_bytes{mountpoint=~"$mount", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))

100 * sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_inodes_usage{mountpoint=~"$mount",state="used", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount",state="used", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m])) / sum by (mountpoint, device, type) (last_over_time(system_filesystem_inodes_usage{mountpoint=~"$mount", host_name="$host" or mountpoint=~"$mount", k8s_node_name="$host"}[5m]))

panels.title: Disk queue
panels.description: Operations waiting for each device. A queue that stays above zero is saturation.

targets.expr: max by (device) (system_disk_pending_operations{device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", host_name="$host" or device!~"loop.*|ram.*|zram.*|dm-.*|sr.*", k8s_node_name="$host"})

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bits per second per interface. Transmit plots below zero.

targets.expr: 8 * sum by (device) (rate(system_network_io_bytes_total{device=~"$iface",direction="receive", host_name="$host" or device=~"$iface",direction="receive", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))
-8 * sum by (device) (rate(system_network_io_bytes_total{device=~"$iface",direction="transmit", host_name="$host" or device=~"$iface",direction="transmit", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: Packets the interface dropped or received damaged, per second. Should stay at zero.

targets.expr: sum by (device, direction) (rate(system_network_errors_total{device=~"$iface", host_name="$host" or device=~"$iface", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (device, direction) (rate(system_network_dropped_total{device=~"$iface", host_name="$host" or device=~"$iface", k8s_node_name="$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP connections by state
panels.description: Sockets per TCP state. Many in TIME_WAIT is normal under load; many in SYN_RECV points at a flood.

targets.expr: sum by (state) (system_network_connections{protocol="tcp", host_name="$host" or protocol="tcp", k8s_node_name="$host"})

panels.title: Who connects to this host
panels.description: New inbound connections over the selected range, grouped by source and destination port. Select an address to follow it across the fleet.

targets.expr: conn.event:=new host.name:="$host" | stats by (source.address, source.network, geo.country_name, destination.port, destination.service, network.transport) count() connections | sort by (connections desc) | limit 100

panels.title: New connections by service
panels.description: Inbound connections per destination service. Refused attempts excluded.

targets.expr: conn.event:=new host.name:="$host" | stats by (destination.service) count() connections

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Journal and pod log lines per interval by level.

targets.expr: (host.name:="$host" or k8s.node.name:="$host") | stats by (severity_text) count() lines

panels.title: Journal
panels.description: Host journal lines, newest first. The search box above filters them.

targets.expr: host.name:="$host" _msg:~"$search"
